book_title: Ned the Bedhog Wants to be a Hedgehog: A Children's Book About Discipline, Responsibility, and Daily Routines for Kids Ages 3-8
author: Benedict Atchley
book_description: Do you have a child who struggles to get out of bed, finish chores, or make the most of their day?Ned the Bedhog Wants to Be a Hedgehog is a charming story about discipline, responsibility, and growing up. Ned is a lovable little hedgehog who would rather sleep the day away. While the other animals wake up, do their chores, and enjoy their day, Ned stays in bed and misses out on the fun.With gentle guidance from his parents, Ned begins to learn an important when we wake up and do what we must first, there is time to enjoy what we love most.Told in playful rhyme, this book is perfect for read-aloud time while teaching valuable life lessons children can understand and enjoy.Perfect for children ages 3 to 8, this book is ideal for bedtime reading, morning routines, homeschool settings, and early classroom environments. It encourages strong habits, responsibility, and a positive attitude toward daily life.Created by a father and daughter team, this story brings heart and meaning to families looking for books that reinforce character and values.If you are looking for a children's book that helps build discipline, responsibility, and confidence, this is a great addition to your home or classroom library.Show more
